milestone.title: mp autopilot restart + reconciliation after orchestrator or pane failure

intent.outcome: Interrupted autopilot sessions resume from durable events without duplicate dispatch, fabricated completion, or loss of evidence.

problem.description: Durable session writes are insufficient unless the orchestrator can reconcile them with live herdr panes and canonical milestone/review state after SIGINT, process death, pane loss, or partial command completion.

in_scope: Resume from last valid event sequence and schema revision.
Reconcile herdr workspace/panes, session roles, milestone criteria, reviews, and lifecycle state.
No duplicate dispatch; explicit outcomes for missing pane, corrupt tail, incompatible binary, and terminal session.
out_of_scope: UI replay rendering and full multi-milestone certification.

acceptance_criteria.description: Resume after orchestrator SIGINT continues from the last durable event without duplicate assignment or lifecycle command.
Missing/dead panes are classified by role and topology; safe respawn uses the stored prompt and actor rotation, while unsafe ambiguity escalates AwaitingUser.
A corrupt or partial event tail recovers the last valid sequence without truncating prior events; incompatible schema/binary fails before mutation.
Reconciliation cross-checks canonical criterion/review/lifecycle state and never restores stale session projections over newer plan evidence.

design_decisions.choice: Canonical milestone criteria, reviews, and lifecycle revisions override stale session projections; append-only events and idempotency keys determine whether an effect may be replayed.
design_decisions.rationale: Recovery must not replace newer plan evidence or duplicate irreversible dispatch and closure commands.

work_packages.name: Restart reconciliation
work_packages.goal: Recover durable sessions against live panes and canonical plan state without duplicate effects.
work_packages.rollback: Leave interrupted sessions AwaitingUser and preserve all durable evidence.

steps.action: Implement resume from event cursor with idempotency keys for dispatch and lifecycle operations.
Reconcile stored role/pane identity with herdr liveness and implement safe respawn versus AwaitingUser classification.
steps.done_when: AC-02 covers each topology and pane-loss role.

steps.action: Recover last valid event sequence and reject incompatible schema/binary before writes.
steps.done_when: AC-03 preserves prior events and makes no mutation on incompatibility.

steps.action: Cross-check canonical criterion, review, and lifecycle revisions during recovery; never restore stale projections.
steps.done_when: AC-04 proves canonical newer evidence wins.
